items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Stan said he was gonna try another bass player... Why you let Wilbur go? ... he was trying out another bass player each night

ctx.x: Naturally, we were gonna cook -- we were gonna play our best, too, and not realizing, you know, Stan Getz -- he's a star; naturally he's a star, but we want to get behind and push him just as much; the rhythm section was pushing Miles. And I don't know, Stan was going through his little problems during that time, and the other one was playing all those poly-rhythms, and Stan was getting confused; he didn't know what to do, so after the first set, we come off the bandstand, and he says, "Elvin" and Elton turned…
So the next time, I was in line for the Riverside Keepnews for my daily sleevng job, and he says what happened, and I said, "Well, Stan said he was gonna try another bass player.'
